products.name: blueMonster
products.one_liner: blueMonster lite: the idea-discovery engine for Mac with MBR export, pool sharing, and signed receipt-backed runs.

products.name: blueGlu
products.one_liner: A calm, private AI assistant for your Mac. Runs on-device by default; escalate on your own terms, never automatically.
products.audience: Anyone who wants a local-first assistant with a frontier model one click away
products.not_this: Not an auto-escalating router — you choose when a question goes past the on-device model.

products.name: Blue
products.one_liner: The verification substrate every MOBLUEHQ product runs on. A private inference mesh that returns sealed, signed results — the scheduler never sees your data, and every answer carries a receipt anyone can verify.
products.audience: Anyone building AI into decisions that carry consequences

products.name: slumberNet
products.one_liner: The compute mesh we're building toward — pool a machine's spare capacity to help run verified AI work. Not a public download yet: today's build is internal and unsigned, run only on our own machines. This is the direction we're building toward, not what happens today.
products.audience: Anyone with a capable machine and spare capacity to share
